Baad mein pata chala ki woh ek din metro breakdown aur ek din hospital ki wajah se late tha. Supervisor ki galti kaunsa model sabse achhe se samjhaata hai?
questions.explanation: Supervisor ne thoda sa data chuna (do din late), uska meaning aur assumption joda, conclusion ('parwaah nahi') aur belief banaya, aur us par action liya: ye seedha ladder of inference par tezi se chadhna hai. Theory Y trap hai: woh employees ke baare mein positive assumption hai, galat inference ka process nahi samjhaata.

questions.question: Ek hospital ki pharmacy par lambi waiting ki complaints hain. Management ka pehla frame hai: 'Hume aur pharmacists chahiye.' Kaunsa reframe problem ko sabse achhe se kholta hai?
options: Hum patients ki complaints kaise kam karein?
Patients kyun wait karte hain, aur prescription se medicine milne tak ke flow mein delay kahan banta hai?
Hum bada waiting hall kaise banaayein?
questions.explanation: Original frame ek solution (aur staff) ko problem bana deta hai. Achha reframe poore flow ko dekhta hai: delay billing par hai, stock dhoondhne mein, ya prescription ki handwriting mein? Complaints kam karna symptom ko target karta hai, slow pharmacist dhoondhna blame par focus karta hai, aur bada hall wait ko comfortable banata hai, kam nahi karta.

questions.question: Ek manager ne kal news mein ek bade cyber attack ki khabar dekhi, aur ab use lagta hai ki cyber attack company ka sabse bada risk hai, jabki company ka apna data kehta hai ki supply delays kahin zyada common hain. Kaunsa bias hai?
questions.explanation: Jo cheez yaad mein aasaani se aaye (taaza, dramatic news), use zyada likely maanna availability bias hai. Anchoring mein ek starting number judgement ko kheenchta hai, jo yahan nahi hai. Framing tab hota jab same fact alag shabdon mein rakhne se decision badalta.

questions.question: Ek close-knit leadership team mein sab log ek naye plan par 'haan' bolte hain. Do members ko gambhir doubts hain, par woh team ki harmony bachaane ke liye chup rehte hain. Ye kya hai?
questions.explanation: Cohesive group mein harmony ke liye doubts dabana aur 'sab agreed' dikhna groupthink hai (Irving Janis). Confirmation bias ek individual ka apne favour ka data dhoondhna hai. Status quo bias purani cheez se chipke rehna hai, jabki yahan to naya plan approve ho raha hai.

questions.question: Ek experienced cashier bina soche turant nakli note pakad leta hai, par naye store ka saal bhar ka budget banaane ke liye use baith kar dhyaan se calculation karni padti hai. Kahneman ke hisaab se nakli note pakadna kis system ka kaam hai?
questions.explanation: Bina effort ke, turant aur automatic judgement System 1 ka kaam hai. Budget ki dhyaan se calculation System 2 hai: slow aur effortful. Ladder of inference aur pre-mortem thinking ke models aur tools hain, Kahneman ke do systems nahi.

questions.question: Launch se pehle ek team leader kehta hai: 'Maan lo ek saal baad ye product flop ho chuka hai. Ab har koi likho ki aisa kyun hua hoga.' Ye kaunsa debiasing tool hai?
questions.explanation: Failure ko pehle se 'ho chuka' maan kar uske kaaran sochna Gary Klein ka pre-mortem hai; isse overconfidence aur groupthink mein dabe risks bahar aate hain. Devil's advocate ek person ko jaan-boojh kar plan ke khilaaf bolne ka role dena hai, poori team ka failure imagine karna nahi. Ladder of inference ek model hai, tool nahi.

questions.question: Ek call centre ke customers shikaayat karte hain ki unki call 5 baar transfer hoti hai aur woh gusse mein aa jaate hain. Manager kehta hai: 'Agents ko politeness training do.' Problem framing mein kya galti hai?
options: Koi galti nahi, kyunki politeness hi asli cause hai
Symptom ka ilaaj; pehle poocho transfer kyun hote hain
Use politeness ki jagah naye agents hire karne chahiye
Use complaints ko positive framing mein likhna chahiye
questions.explanation: Gussa symptom hai; underlying problem shayad galat call routing ya agents ke paas authority ki kami hai. Manager ne symptom ke liye ek solution pakad liya bina 'kyun' pooche. Naye agents hire karna bhi wahi galti hai: ek aur solution ko problem bana dena. Positive framing complaint ki wording badalta hai, problem nahi.

questions.question: Ek company warehouse automation par ₹12 crore kharch kar chuki hai. Option P: ₹6 crore aur lagakar project poora karo; future benefit ₹10 crore. Option Q: project chhodo, machines ₹2 crore mein bech do, aur kuch naya mat karo. Option R: project chhodo, machines ₹2 crore mein becho, aur ₹5 crore ka ready system lo jo ₹9 crore benefit de. Sabse rational choice kya hai?
options: P: ₹12 crore ka investment bachaane ke liye poora karo
Q: machines bechkar ₹2 crore lo, sabse safe raasta
P: future net +₹4 crore, jo sabse zyada hai
R: future net +₹6 crore, jo sabse zyada hai
questions.explanation: ₹12 crore sunk hai, isliye teeno options mein ignore karo. P: 10 − 6 = +₹4 crore. Q: +₹2 crore. R: 2 + 9 − 5 = +₹6 crore. Sabse zyada R hai. Pehla option seedha sunk cost fallacy hai. Teesra option P ka number sahi nikaalta hai par R ko compare hi nahi karta, aur Q 'safe' lagta hai par sabse kam value deta hai.

questions.question: Teen situations: (1) salary negotiation mein candidate ne pehle ₹18 lakh bola, aur HR ka final offer ₹16 lakh par ruka, jabki HR ka original budget ₹12 lakh tha; (2) ek patient ne '95% survival rate' sunke surgery chuni, par '5% mortality rate' sunke mana kar diya; (3) ek investor sirf woh articles padhta hai jo uske favourite stock ki taareef karein. Kramashah kaunse biases hain?
questions.explanation: (1) Pehla number (₹18 lakh) anchor bana aur offer ko budget se upar kheench le gaya: anchoring. (2) 95% survival aur 5% mortality same fact hain, sirf gain vs loss wording alag: framing. (3) Sirf apni raay ke favour ki info padhna: confirmation bias. Trap: pehla option, jo (1) aur (2) ko swap karta hai, kyunki dono mein numbers dikhte hain; farak ye hai ki anchoring mein ek starting number kheenchta hai, framing mein same fact ki wording.

questions.question: Ek manager maanta hai ki 'freshers loyal nahi hote'. Ab jab koi fresher ek din ki chhutti leta hai to woh use 'interview dene gaya hoga' ka saboot maanta hai, aur freshers ke achhe kaam ko notice hi nahi karta. Ladder of inference ka kaunsa hissa ye explain karta hai, aur remedy kya hai?
options: Reflexive loop: belief data chun raha hai; neeche utro, poora data dekho
Sunk cost: purane hiring kharch ka asar; ab freshers ki hiring band karo
Anchoring: pehle number ka asar; apna independent estimate banao
Groupthink: team harmony ka asar; meeting mein ek devil's advocate rakho
questions.explanation: Ladder par bane belief ('freshers loyal nahi') ab agli baar kaunsa data chuna jaaye use affect kar raha hai: chhutti notice hoti hai, achha kaam nahi. Ye reflexive loop hai. Remedy: seedhi se neeche utro, poocho 'iska data kya hai?', aur saara observable data dekho. Sunk cost aur anchoring mein past kharch ya starting number chahiye, jo yahan nahi; groupthink group ka phenomenon hai, jabki ye ek insaan ki soch hai.

questions.question: 'Kiran Kitchens' (fictional) ka plan hai: 'Price 10% kam karenge; sales badhengi, aur competitor apna price nahi ghataayega.' Ek manager poochta hai: 'Agar competitor ne bhi 10% kam kar diya to plan ka kya hoga?' Manager kya kar raha hai, aur isse kaunsa bias sabse zyada kam hota hai?
options: Anchoring kar raha hai; isse framing effect kam hota hai
Sunk cost dekh raha hai; isse groupthink kam hota hai
Assumption ko test kar raha hai; isse overconfidence kam hota hai
Ladder par chadh raha hai; isse confirmation bias badhta hai
questions.explanation: Plan ke peeche ek hidden assumption hai ('competitor price nahi ghataayega'). Manager use likh kar poochta hai ki ye galat hui to kya hoga: ye assumption testing aur 'consider the opposite' hai, jo plan ke baare mein overconfidence kam karta hai. 10% ek starting number nahi jo kisi estimate ko kheench raha ho, isliye anchoring galat hai. Koi past kharch nahi, isliye sunk cost nahi. Manager data se seedha sawaal kar raha hai, jaldi conclusion nahi bana raha, isliye ladder wala option bhi ulta hai.

weeks.title: Tools for Critical and Creative Thinking
weeks.summary: Is week aap problem solving ke practical tools seekhoge: five whys, fishbone diagram, Pareto analysis, SWOT/TOWS, de Bono ke six thinking hats, lateral thinking, brainstorming aur SCAMPER.
concepts: **Critical vs creative thinking**: Critical (convergent) thinking options ko judge karke ek par pahunchti hai; creative (divergent) thinking naye options banaati hai. Achhe problem solving mein dono chahiye, par ek saath nahi: pehle ideas generate karo, phir evaluate karo. Dono ko mix karne se naye ideas paida hote hi mar jaate hain.

**Five whys**: Toyota ke production system se popular hua. Problem par baar-baar 'kyun?' poocho jab tak process ya system level ka root cause na mil jaaye (number 5 fixed rule nahi, rough guide hai). Limitation: ek hi chain follow karta hai, kai causes miss ho sakte hain, aur 'operator ki galti' par ruk kar blame game ban sakta hai.

**Fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram**: Kaoru Ishikawa ka cause-and-effect diagram. Machhli ke sir par effect (problem) likho, aur haddiyon par causes ki categories. Manufacturing mein common **6M**: man (people), machine, method, material, measurement, mother nature (environment). Ye ek saath kai causes ko organise karta hai, jo five whys nahi karta.

**Pareto analysis**: Aksar thode se causes zyada tar problems paida karte hain (rough 80/20 pattern). Causes ko frequency ke descending order mein lagao, cumulative % nikaalo, aur pehle 'vital few' par kaam karo, 'trivial many' par nahi.

**SWOT aur TOWS**: SWOT mein **strengths** aur **weaknesses** internal hain (company ke control mein), **opportunities** aur **threats** external (environment se). TOWS matrix strategies banaata hai: SO (strength se opportunity pakdo), WO (weakness theek karke opportunity lo), ST (strength se threat roko), WT (weakness aur threat dono se bachao).

**Six thinking hats (Edward de Bono)**: Group ek time par ek hi tarah ki soch karta hai (parallel thinking). **White**: facts aur data. **Red**: feelings, intuition. **Black**: caution, risks. **Yellow**: benefits, optimism. **Green**: creativity, naye alternatives. **Blue**: thinking process ko manage karna (agenda, summary, next step).

**Lateral thinking aur brainstorming**: de Bono ka lateral thinking seedhi logic ki line chhod kar naye angle se dekhna hai: assumptions challenge karo, random word se jodo, ya provocation do ('kya ho agar dukaan mein counter hi na ho?'). Alex Osborn ke brainstorming rules: judgement baad mein, quantity chahiye, wild ideas welcome, doosron ke ideas par build karo.

**SCAMPER**: Existing product ya process ko badalne ki checklist: Substitute (kisi part ki jagah kuch aur), Combine (do cheezein jodo), Adapt (kahin aur se idea lo), Modify/magnify/minify, Put to other uses (naya use), Eliminate (kuch hatao), Reverse/rearrange (order ulta karo). Bob Eberle ne ise Osborn ki idea checklist se banaaya tha.

example.problem: 'Dakiya Couriers' (fictional) ki Jaipur branch mein 30% parcels late deliver ho rahe hain. Five whys lagaao.
steps: Why 1: Parcels late kyun hain? Kyunki delivery vans dopahar 12 baje ke baad nikalti hain.
Why 2: Vans late kyun nikalti hain? Kyunki sorting subah 11:30 tak khatam nahi hoti.
Why 3: Sorting late kyun hoti hai? Kyunki raat ki truck se aaye parcels subah 9 baje unload hote hain.
Why 4: Unloading late kyun? Kyunki raat mein unloading staff ki shift hi nahi hai.
Why 5: Shift kyun nahi hai? Kyunki shift schedule 3 saal pehle bana tha jab truck subah aati thi, aur kisi ne update nahi kiya.
Root cause system level par hai: purana shift schedule. Fix: raat ki unloading shift, sirf drivers ko daantna nahi.
Answer: Root cause **outdated shift schedule** hai; isse theek karna symptom (late vans) ka asli ilaaj hai.

mistakes: Five whys ko ek insaan par rok dena ('driver lazy hai'). Root cause aam taur par process ya system mein hota hai; wahan tak poochte raho.
SWOT mein internal aur external mix karna. 'Naya competitor aa raha hai' threat hai, weakness nahi; 'hamara supply chain slow hai' weakness hai, threat nahi.
Brainstorming ke dauraan hi ideas ko criticise karna. Pehle quantity, judgement baad mein (black hat baad mein pehno).
revision: Five whys: ek chain, root cause tak; blame par mat ruko.
Fishbone: kai causes, categories (6M).
Pareto: vital few causes pehle.
SWOT: S, W internal; O, T external. TOWS se strategies.
Hats: white facts, red feelings, black risks, yellow benefits, green ideas, blue process.
SCAMPER: substitute, combine, adapt, modify, put to other uses, eliminate, reverse.

questions.question: Meeting mein ek manager kehta hai: 'Abhi opinions nahi, sirf facts: pichhle quarter mein returns 6% the aur unme se aadhe size issue ki wajah se.' Six thinking hats mein ye kaunsi hat hai?
questions.explanation: White hat sirf facts, data aur information ki hai. Red hat feelings ki, yellow benefits ki. Blue hat trap hai kyunki manager meeting ko direct kar raha lagta hai, par jo content woh maang raha hai woh pure data hai.

questions.question: Ek regional snack brand ki SWOT analysis mein 'ek bada national brand kam price par hamare shehar mein aa raha hai' kis category mein jaayega?
questions.explanation: Competitor ka aana external factor hai jo nuksaan kar sakta hai, isliye threat. Weakness internal hoti hai, jaise apna slow distribution. Trap: weakness, kyunki brand competitor ke saamne kamzor feel karta hai, par source bahar ka hai.

questions.question: Ek restaurant dopahar 3 se 6 baje khaali rehne wale dining hall ko co-working space ki tarah rent par dena shuru karta hai. SCAMPER ka kaunsa letter hai?
questions.explanation: Existing resource (khaali hall) ko ek bilkul naye use mein lagana 'Put to other uses' hai. Combine trap hai: wahan do products ya features ko jodkar ek nayi cheez banti hai, jabki yahan same hall ka sirf use badla hai.

questions.question: Ek biscuit factory defects ka fishbone diagram bana rahi hai. 'Naye supplier ke aate mein moisture zyada hai' kis 6M category mein jaayega?
questions.explanation: Aata ek raw material input hai, isliye uski quality ki problem material category mein jaati hai. Measurement trap hai kyunki moisture ek measured value hai, par measurement category tab hoti jab naapne ka tareeka ya instrument galat hota.

questions.question: Ek online store ko 200 complaints mili: late delivery 110, wrong item 50, damaged item 25, rude staff 10, other 5. Pareto analysis ke hisaab se pehle kin do categories par focus karna chahiye, aur woh kitna % complaints cover karti hain?
questions.explanation: Sabse badi do categories late delivery (110) aur wrong item (50) hain: (110 + 50) ÷ 200 = 160 ÷ 200 = 80%. Ye 'vital few' hain. Late delivery aur damaged ka 67.5% sahi calculation hai par doosri sabse badi category (wrong item) chhod deta hai.

questions.question: 'Saffron Tea Co.' (fictional) ka north India mein strong brand hai, aur south India mein ready-to-drink tea ki demand tezi se badh rahi hai. Company apne brand name ke saath south mein ready-to-drink tea launch karti hai. TOWS matrix mein ye kaunsi strategy hai?
questions.explanation: Internal strength (strong brand) ka use karke external opportunity (badhti demand) pakadna SO strategy hai. WO tab hota jab company pehle kisi weakness ko theek karke opportunity leti; ST mein strength se kisi threat ka mukabla hota. Trap: ST, kyunki naye market mein jaana risky lagta hai, par yahan koi threat mention hi nahi hai.

questions.question: Meeting mein ek member kehta hai: 'Is plan mein risk ye hai ki supplier time par maal nahi dega, aur hamara penalty clause bhi weak hai.' Six thinking hats mein ye kaunsi hat hai?
questions.explanation: Risks, caution aur kya galat ho sakta hai, ye black hat ki soch hai. White hat neutral facts ki hai, yellow benefits ki aur green naye ideas ki. Trap: white hat, kyunki supplier aur contract ki baat factual lagti hai; par member facts nahi, risk bata raha hai.

questions.question: Ek bakery ki SWOT analysis mein 'hamare paas shehar ke sabse experienced bakers hain' kis category mein jaayega?
questions.explanation: Experienced bakers bakery ke andar ka, uske control wala positive factor hain, isliye strength. Opportunity aur threat external factors hain jo environment se aate hain. Trap: opportunity, kyunki ye achhi baat hai; par source internal hai.

questions.question: Brainstorming session mein ek member har naye idea par turant bolta hai 'ye nahi chalega'. Osborn ka kaunsa rule toot raha hai?
options: Doosron ke ideas par build karo
questions.explanation: Osborn ka pehla rule hai ki ideas generate karte waqt judgement roko; criticism baad mein. Turant 'ye nahi chalega' bolna isi rule ko todta hai aur log naye ideas dena band kar dete hain. Baaki rules bhi kamzor padte hain, par seedha violation judgement defer karne wale rule ka hai.

questions.question: Ek budget hotel apne rooms se telephone aur bathtub hata kar room ka price kam kar deta hai. SCAMPER ka kaunsa letter hai?
questions.explanation: Product ya service se kuch hissa hata dena Eliminate hai. Substitute tab hota jab bathtub ki jagah kuch aur (jaise shower) lagaaya jaata. Trap: substitute, kyunki guests shayad mobile use karenge; par hotel ne koi replacement nahi diya, sirf hataaya hai.

questions.question: Machine breakdown ki problem par ek team ne five whys lagaaye, 'operator ne galti ki' par ruk gayi, aur operator ko warning de di. Is analysis ki sabse badi kami kya hai?
options: Team ne 5 se zyada baar 'kyun' pooch liya, jo mana hai
Five whys sirf service companies mein kaam karta hai
Blame par ruk gaye; system level ka cause nahi dhoondha
Unhe five whys se pehle SWOT analysis karna tha
questions.explanation: Five whys ka goal process ya system level ka root cause hai; 'operator ki galti' par rukna blame game hai. Aage poochna chahiye tha: galti kyun hui? Training, SOP ya machine design mein kya kami thi? 5 koi fixed rule nahi, rough guide hai, isliye pehla option galat hai. Five whys Toyota ke production system se aaya, yaani manufacturing mein bhi kaam karta hai.

questions.question: Ek app ko ek mahine mein 400 bug reports mili: login 140, payment 100, UI 60, notifications 50, search 30, other 20. Pareto analysis mein, kam se kam kitni sabse badi categories lene par 80% ya usse zyada reports cover hongi?
questions.explanation: Descending order mein cumulative: login 140 (35%), + payment = 240 (60%), + UI = 300 (75%), + notifications = 350 (87.5%). 80% pehli baar 4 categories par cross hota hai. 3 categories 75% par ruk jaati hain, jo 80% se kam hai. 5 categories bhi 80% se upar hain, par sawaal kam se kam ka hai. Ye 4 'vital few' pehle fix karne chahiye.

questions.question: 'Nadi Cycles' (fictional) ki after-sales service kamzor hai, aur ek bada online competitor ghar par free service ke saath market mein aa raha hai. Company ek local repair chain ke saath partnership karke apna service network banaati hai taaki customers competitor ki taraf na jaayein. TOWS matrix mein ye kaunsi strategy hai?
questions.explanation: Step 1: kamzor after-sales service internal weakness (W) hai. Step 2: naya competitor external threat (T) hai. Step 3: partnership weakness ko theek karke threat se bachaati hai, isliye WT. Trap: ST, kyunki company threat ka jawab de rahi hai; par yahan kisi strength ka use nahi, weakness ki bharpaai hai. WO tab hota jab weakness theek karke koi opportunity pakdi jaati.

questions.question: Ek hospital lab mein report delays ke 30 possible causes hain jo staff, equipment, methods aur samples se jude hain. Team pehle saare causes ko categories mein organise karna chahti hai, phir sabse frequent causes chunna, phir top cause ka root cause nikaalna. Sahi tool sequence kya hai?
questions.explanation: Kai causes ko categories (man, machine, method, material...) mein organise karna fishbone diagram ka kaam hai. Frequency se 'vital few' chunna Pareto hai. Ek chune hue cause ki chain par baar-baar 'kyun' poochna five whys hai. Doosra option five whys ko pehle rakhta hai, par five whys ek chain follow karta hai aur 30 causes organise nahi karta. SWOT aur SCAMPER strategy aur idea generation ke tools hain, root cause ke nahi.

questions.question: Ek product meeting mein facilitator kehta hai: 'Pehle 10 minute sab sirf naye ideas do, phir hum unke risks dekhenge, aur end mein main summary karke next steps tay karunga.' Teeno phases kramashah kaunsi hats hain, aur facilitator ka apna role kaunsi hat ka hai?
questions.explanation: Naye ideas green hat hain, risks black hat, aur summary aur next steps tay karna blue hat (thinking process manage karna). Facilitator poori meeting ka agenda aur order chala raha hai, isliye uska role bhi blue hat hai. Teesra option summary ko white maanta hai, par summary facts ikattha karna nahi, process control hai. Yellow benefits ki hat hai, ideas ki nahi.

weeks.title: Systems Thinking I: Stocks, Flows and Feedback
weeks.summary: Is week aap systems thinking ki basics seekhoge: system kya hota hai, boundary kaise choose karte hain, stocks aur flows, causal links ki polarity, reinforcing aur balancing feedback loops, aur delays kaise oscillation paida karte hain.
concepts: **System**: Elements ka aisa set jo aapas mein jude hain aur milkar koi purpose ya function poora karte hain (Donella Meadows ka simple definition: elements, interconnections, purpose). System ka behaviour uske structure se aata hai, isliye whole ko sirf parts alag-alag dekh kar nahi samjha ja sakta; ise **emergence** kehte hain.

**Iceberg model**: Upar dikhne wale **events** (is mahine sales giri), unke neeche **patterns** (har festive season ke baad girti hai), unke neeche **structure** (discount policy, inventory rules) aur sabse neeche **mental models** (beliefs). Events par react karna firefighting hai; leverage structure aur mental models badalne mein hai.

**Boundary aur environment**: Kya system ke andar maanein aur kya bahar, ye analyst ka judgement hai. Boundary bahut chhoti rakhi to important causes bahar chhoot jaate hain; bahut badi rakhi to analysis unmanageable. Open system environment se lagaataar exchange karta hai.

**Stocks aur flows**: **Stock** kisi bhi samay jama hui quantity hai (inventory, bank balance, employees, reputation). **Flow** rate hai jo stock ko badalta hai (inflow: hiring, production; outflow: attrition, sales). Stock sirf flows se badalta hai: naya stock = purana stock + (inflow − outflow) × time. Bathtub ka example: nal inflow, drain outflow, paani stock.

**Causal link polarity**: A se B ka arrow **+ (same direction)** matlab A badhe to B badhe (baaki sab same rehte hue), aur A ghate to B ghate. **− (opposite direction)** matlab A badhe to B ghate. Polarity direction batati hai, size nahi.

**Reinforcing loop (R)**: Change ko aur badhaata hai: growth ya collapse dono. Word of mouth: zyada customers → zyada recommendations → aur zyada customers. Ulta chale to vicious circle: kam customers → kam recommendations → aur kam customers. Compound interest bhi reinforcing hai.

**Balancing loop (B)**: Goal-seeking; system ko ek target ki taraf laata hai aur change ka virodh karta hai. Thermostat, inventory reorder rule, hunger aur khaana. **Loop polarity rule**: loop mein negative (−) links gino; even number (0, 2, 4) to reinforcing, odd number (1, 3) to balancing.

**Delays**: Action aur uske effect ke beech ka time. Balancing loop mein delay ho to system **overshoot** karta hai aur **oscillate** karta hai: shower ka paani, hiring cycles, supply chain mein orders ka badhte jaana (bullwhip effect, jise beer game mein dikhate hain). Delay ke saath sabr aur chhote adjustments zaroori hain.

example.problem: Ek warehouse mein abhi 500 units stock hai. Har week 120 units aate hain (inflow) aur 150 units dispatch hote hain (outflow). 4 weeks baad stock kitna hoga? Aur agar manager stock gap dekh kar orders badhata hai, to kaunsa loop banta hai?
steps: Net flow per week = inflow − outflow = 120 − 150 = −30 units.
4 weeks mein change = 4 × (−30) = −120 units.
Naya stock = 500 − 120 = 380 units.
Loop: stock gap (desired − actual) → (+) orders → (+) incoming stock → (+) actual stock → (−) stock gap.
Negative links = 1 (odd), isliye ye balancing loop hai jo stock ko target ki taraf laata hai.
Answer: Stock **380 units**; ordering rule ek **balancing loop** hai (supplier delay ho to overshoot ho sakta hai).

mistakes: Stock aur flow mix karna. 'Number of employees' stock hai; 'hiring per month' flow. Check: kya ise kisi ek pal par gin sakte ho (stock) ya ye 'per time' hai (flow)?
Loop type sirf words se judge karna ('ye bura hai to balancing hoga'). Polarity rule lagao: negative links gino; vicious circle bhi reinforcing hota hai.
Delay ko ignore karke turant aur bada correction karna. Isse overshoot aur oscillation badhta hai.
revision: System = elements + interconnections + purpose; behaviour structure se aata hai.
Stock = jama quantity; flow = rate. Naya stock = purana + (in − out) × time.
+ link same direction, − link opposite direction.
Even negative links = R; odd = B.
R loop: growth/collapse. B loop: goal-seeking.
Delay + balancing loop = overshoot aur oscillation.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa stock hai, flow nahi?
options: Har mahine customers ka chhod kar jaana (churn)
Company mein employees ki kul sankhya
questions.explanation: Employees ki kul sankhya kisi ek pal par gini ja sakti hai, isliye stock hai. Hiring, daily sales aur monthly churn sab 'per time' rates hain, yaani flows jo stocks ko badalte hain. Trap: rozana sales, kyunki woh ek number lagta hai, par woh per day rate hai.

questions.question: Zyada satisfied customers → zyada word-of-mouth → zyada naye customers → zyada satisfied customers. Ye kaunsa loop hai?
questions.explanation: Har link same direction mein hai (sab +), negative links zero hain (even), isliye reinforcing loop: change apne aap ko aur badhaata hai. Balancing loop kisi target ki taraf le jaata aur growth ko rokta; yahan koi goal ya limit nahi dikh rahi.

questions.question: Ek tank mein 800 litres paani hai. Inflow 50 litres per minute aur outflow 70 litres per minute hai. 15 minutes baad tank mein kitna paani hoga?
questions.explanation: Net flow = 50 − 70 = −20 litres per minute. 15 minutes mein change = 15 × (−20) = −300 litres. Stock = 800 − 300 = 500 litres. 300 litres sirf change hai, stock nahi; 1100 inflow aur outflow ko ulta lene par aata hai; 750 sirf ek minute ka inflow ghataane se.

questions.question: Loop: inventory gap → (+) orders → (+) inventory → (−) inventory gap. Ye kaunsa loop hai aur kyun?
options: Balancing, kyunki loop mein ek negative link hai (odd number)
Reinforcing, kyunki do positive links hain
Reinforcing, kyunki loop mein teen links hain
Na reinforcing na balancing, kyunki loop mein delay nahi hai
questions.explanation: Loop ka type negative links ki ginti se tay hota hai: yahan ek − link hai, jo odd hai, isliye balancing. Matlab gap badhe to orders badhte hain, inventory badhti hai, aur gap phir kam ho jaata hai: goal-seeking. Positive links ya total links ki ginti se type tay nahi hota, aur delay hone ya na hone se bhi loop ka type nahi badalta.

questions.question: Hostel ke shower mein aap garam paani ka knob ghumaate ho, par paani 20 seconds tak thanda rehta hai. Aap aur ghumaate ho, phir paani bahut garam ho jaata hai, aap ulta zyada ghuma dete ho aur paani phir thanda. Systems thinking mein iska sabse achha explanation kya hai?
options: Ye ek reinforcing loop hai jo growth paida karta hai
Ye balancing loop hai jisme delay hai, isliye overshoot aur oscillation ho raha hai
Ye ek stock hai jisme koi flow nahi
questions.explanation: Aap ek target temperature ki taraf adjust kar rahe ho, yaani balancing (goal-seeking) loop. Par knob aur temperature ke beech delay hai, isliye aap zaroorat se zyada correct karte ho aur paani target ke aar-paar jhoolta hai. Reinforcing trap hai: yahan cheez ek hi direction mein badhti nahi ja rahi, upar-neeche ho rahi hai.

questions.question: Sirf is ek loop ko dekho: backlog → (+) overtime hours → (+) fatigue → (−) productivity → (−) backlog. Ye kaunsa loop hai?
options: Balancing, kyunki loop mein negative links hain
Balancing, kyunki overtime se backlog kam hota hai
Reinforcing nahi ho sakta, kyunki fatigue buri cheez hai
Reinforcing, kyunki 2 negative links hain (even): backlog badhne se backlog aur badhta hai
questions.explanation: Negative links gino: fatigue → productivity aur productivity → backlog, yaani 2, jo even hai, isliye reinforcing. Trace karo: backlog badha → overtime badha → fatigue badhi → productivity giri → backlog aur badha: vicious circle. 'Negative links hain to balancing' sabse common trap hai; type ginti ke odd ya even hone se tay hota hai. Overtime se backlog seedha kam hona ek alag balancing loop hai jo is loop mein drawn nahi hai.

questions.question: Causal link: 'Advertising → (+) Sales'. Agar baaki sab same rehte hue advertising ghat jaaye, to sales ka kya hoga?
questions.explanation: + polarity ka matlab same direction: cause ghate to effect bhi ghate. Isliye advertising kam hone par sales ghategi. 'Sales badhegi' − link ka matlab hota. Polarity sirf direction batati hai, size nahi, isliye 'zero ho jaayegi' galat hai.

questions.question: 'Har saal March mein overtime achanak badh jaata hai' iceberg model ke kis level par hai?
questions.explanation: Baar-baar dohraane wala trend (har saal March mein) pattern hai. Event ek single ghatna hoti, jaise 'is March overtime badha'. Structure woh rules aur policies hain jo is pattern ko paida karte hain (jaise year-end targets), aur mental models unke peeche ke beliefs.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa flow hai, stock nahi?
questions.explanation: Monthly interest 'per time' rate hai jo bank balance (stock) ko badhaata hai, isliye flow hai. Bank balance, inventory aur reputation kisi ek pal par naape ja sakte hain, isliye stocks hain. Trap: reputation, kyunki woh abstract lagti hai; par woh bhi samay ke saath jama hone wali quantity hai.

questions.question: Ek company mein 1 January ko 240 employees the. Har mahine 12 log join karte hain aur 18 chhod dete hain. 6 mahine baad, 30 June ko, employees kitne honge?
questions.explanation: Net flow = 12 − 18 = −6 per month. 6 mahine mein change = 6 × (−6) = −36. Stock = 240 − 36 = 204. 276 sign ulta lene par aata hai. 132 sirf outflow (18 × 6 = 108) ghataane aur hiring bhool jaane par aata hai. 234 sirf ek mahine ka change hai.

questions.question: Shehar ke traffic jam ko samajhne ke liye ek analyst sirf traffic signals ki timing ko system maanta hai, aur nayi housing colonies, metro aur parking rules ko boundary se bahar rakhta hai. Is analysis ka sabse bada risk kya hai?
options: Boundary bahut badi hai, analysis unmanageable ho jaayega
Signals stock hain, isliye analysis galat hoga
Is system mein koi feedback loop ho hi nahi sakta
Boundary bahut chhoti hai; important causes bahar chhoot gaye
questions.explanation: Housing, metro aur parking rules traffic ke important causes hain. Unhe bahar rakhne se boundary bahut chhoti ho gayi aur analysis asli drivers miss karega. Pehla option ulta hai: problem zyada badi nahi, zyada chhoti boundary hai. Signal timing ek rule ya setting hai, stock nahi, aur traffic mein feedback loops zaroor hote hain.

questions.question: Loop: product quality → (−) complaints → (−) customer trust → (+) sales → (+) R&D budget → (+) product quality. Ye kaunsa loop hai?
options: Balancing, kyunki complaints ek buri cheez hain
Balancing, kyunki loop mein 5 links hain (odd)
questions.explanation: Negative links gino: quality → complaints aur complaints → trust, yaani 2, jo even hai, isliye reinforcing. Trace: quality badhi → complaints ghati → trust badha → sales badhi → R&D badha → quality aur badhi. Rule negative links ki ginti par hai, total links (5) par nahi. 'Buri cheez hai to balancing' words se judge karne ki galti hai.

questions.question: Ek reservoir mein 10,000 litres paani hai. Pehle 3 ghante inflow 800 litres per hour aur outflow 500 litres per hour hai. Agle 2 ghante inflow 200 litres per hour aur outflow 1,100 litres per hour hai. 5 ghante baad reservoir mein kitna paani hoga?
questions.explanation: Phase 1: net = 800 − 500 = +300 per hour, 3 ghante mein +900, stock = 10,900. Phase 2: net = 200 − 1,100 = −900 per hour, 2 ghante mein −1,800, stock = 10,900 − 1,800 = 9,100 litres. 10,900 sirf pehle phase ke baad ka stock hai. 8,200 pehle phase ka +900 bhool jaane par aata hai, aur 11,800 doosre phase ka sign ulta lene par.

questions.question: Ek retailer har week stock gap (target − actual) dekh kar order deta hai, par supplier 3 weeks baad deliver karta hai. Manager pehle se diye gaye, raaste mein pade orders ko ignore karta hai aur jab tak stock target tak na aa jaaye, har week gap ke hisaab se naya order deta rehta hai. Kya hoga?
options: Stock smoothly target par rukega, kyunki loop balancing hai
Stock exponentially badhta jaayega, kyunki loop reinforcing hai
Delay ki wajah se loop ka type badal kar reinforcing ho jaayega
Overshoot: pipeline orders ignore hue, balancing loop mein delay
questions.explanation: Ordering rule balancing (goal-seeking) loop hai, par 3 weeks ka delay hai. Jab tak pehle orders pahunchte hain, manager aur orders de chuka hota hai, isliye stock target se upar chala jaata hai, phir orders rukte hain aur stock neeche: overshoot aur oscillation. Smooth approach tab hota jab delay na hota ya pipeline count hoti. Delay loop ka type nahi badalta, sirf behaviour; aur ye loop reinforcing nahi hai.

questions.question: Loop: price → (−) demand → (−) inventory → (−) price. (Zyada demand inventory ko ghataati hai, aur zyada inventory price ko neeche laati hai.) Agar price 10% badh jaaye, to ye loop aage kya karega?
options: Reinforcing: price aur upar jaati rahegi lagaataar
Reinforcing: saare links negative hain, isliye
Balancing: 3 negative links, price waapas giregi
Balancing: kyunki har loop mein delay hota hi hai
questions.explanation: Negative links = 3, jo odd hai, isliye balancing. Trace: price badhi → demand ghati → inventory badhi (demand kam, isliye stock jama) → price ghati. Yaani loop price ke badhne ka virodh karta hai. 'Saare negative hain to reinforcing' galat rule hai; odd ginti balancing deti hai. Loop ka type delay se nahi, polarity se tay hota hai.

weeks.title: Systems Thinking II: Causal Loop Diagrams and Archetypes
weeks.summary: Is week aap causal loop diagrams (CLD) banana aur padhna seekhoge, aur common system archetypes pehchaanoge: limits to growth, shifting the burden, fixes that fail, tragedy of the commons, escalation, success to the successful aur eroding goals.
concepts: **Causal loop diagram (CLD)**: Variables (aisi cheezein jo badh-ghat sakti hain, jaise 'customer satisfaction', 'delivery time') ko arrows se jodo. Har arrow par + ya − polarity, delay ho to arrow par do lakeerein (||), aur har loop par R ya B label. Variable names neutral rakho ('quality', na ki 'better quality'), aur actions ki jagah quantities likho.

**System archetypes**: Kuch loop structures alag-alag companies aur industries mein baar-baar dikhte hain. Peter Senge ne 'The Fifth Discipline' (1990) mein inhe popular kiya. Archetype pehchaanne ka fayda: kaunsa intervention kaam karega (leverage) aur kaunsa ulta padega, ye pehle se pata chal jaata hai.

**Limits to growth**: Ek reinforcing loop growth deta hai, par growth ek limiting factor (capacity, staff, market size) se takraati hai aur ek balancing loop growth ko dheema ya band kar deta hai. Galti: growth ko aur zor se dhakelna (zyada ads). Leverage: limiting factor ko pehchaan kar pehle use dheela karna.

**Shifting the burden**: Problem ke do solution hain: ek **symptomatic quick fix** (jaldi, aasaan) aur ek **fundamental solution** (slow, mushkil, delay ke saath). Quick fix baar-baar use hone se fundamental solution kamzor padta jaata hai, aur aksar ek side-effect (jaise dependence ya addiction) bhi aata hai. Example: har baar discount dekar sales bachaana, product improve na karna.

**Fixes that fail**: Ek fix symptom ko abhi theek karta hai, par delay ke baad uska unintended consequence wahi problem aur badha deta hai. Example: maintenance budget kaat kar profit bachaana, phir breakdowns se zyada loss. Shifting the burden se fark: yahan alag fundamental solution ki kahani nahi, fix khud hi baad mein problem waapas laata hai.

**Tragedy of the commons**: Garrett Hardin ka 1968 ka essay. Kai users ek shared resource (lake ki machhli, groundwater, shared server) se apna fayda badhaate hain; har ek ka individual gain hai par cost sab mein bant-ti hai. Total use resource ki limit cross karta hai aur resource collapse hota hai. Leverage: shared rules, quotas, monitoring; Elinor Ostrom ne dikhaya ki communities khud bhi achhe rules bana sakti hain.

**Escalation aur success to the successful**: Escalation mein do parties ek doosre ke action ko threat maan kar react karti hain (price war, arms race); dono ke balancing loops milkar ek bada reinforcing loop banate hain. Success to the successful mein jo pehle jeeta use zyada resources milte hain, jisse woh aur jeet-ta hai aur doosra pichhe reh jaata hai.

**Eroding goals**: Goal aur actual ke beech gap ho to do raaste hain: performance sudhaaro, ya goal neeche kar do. Agar baar-baar goal hi neeche kiya jaaye to standards dheere-dheere gir jaate hain. Leverage: goal ko hold karo aur actual performance par kaam karo. Ye shifting the burden ka ek special case maana jaata hai.

example.problem: 'Pragati Coaching Centre' (fictional) ke results achhe the, isliye word of mouth se admissions tezi se badhe. Par faculty utni hi rahi, batch size 40 se 90 ho gaya, doubt clearing kam hui, results gire aur do saal baad admissions ruk gaye. CLD aur archetype batao.
steps: Reinforcing loop R: admissions → (+) satisfied students → (+) word of mouth → (+) admissions. Saare links + hain, isliye growth engine.
Limiting factor: faculty capacity fixed hai.
Balancing loop B: admissions → (+) students per teacher → (−) attention per student → (+) results → (+) reputation → (+) admissions. Isme negative link sirf ek hai (odd), isliye balancing.
Shuru mein R dominate karta hai (growth), baad mein B dominate karta hai (stall).
Galat response: aur ads chalaana; isse students per teacher aur badhega.
Answer: Ye **limits to growth** hai; leverage hai faculty capacity badhaana ya batch size cap karna, growth ko dhakelna nahi.

mistakes: Shifting the burden aur fixes that fail ko same samajhna. Shifting the burden mein ek fundamental solution exist karta hai jo quick fix ki wajah se neglect hota hai; fixes that fail mein fix ka apna side-effect delay ke baad problem waapas laata hai.
CLD mein variable ko action ki tarah likhna ('hire more'). Quantity likho ('number of staff') taaki + ya − ka matlab saaf rahe.
Limits to growth mein growth engine ko aur zor se chalaana. Leverage limiting factor par hai.
revision: CLD: variables, +/− arrows, || delay, R/B loop labels.
Limits to growth: R growth + B limit; limit par kaam karo.
Shifting the burden: quick fix fundamental solution ko kamzor karta hai.
Fixes that fail: fix ka side-effect delay ke baad problem badhaata hai.
Tragedy of the commons: shared resource, individual gain, collective collapse.
Eroding goals: gap par goal neeche karna; goal hold karo.

questions.question: Ek jheel par kai fishing boats hain. Har boat apne profit ke liye zyada machhli pakadti hai, kyunki 'meri ek boat se kya farq padega'. Kuch saal baad machhli ki aabaadi collapse ho jaati hai. Kaunsa archetype hai?
questions.explanation: Shared resource, har user ka individual gain, aur cost sab mein bant-ne se total use limit ke paar: ye tragedy of the commons hai. Limits to growth trap hai, kyunki growth limit se takraati hai, par wahan ek hi actor ki growth hoti hai, kai users ka shared resource nahi.

questions.question: Causal loop diagram mein 'Price' se 'Demand' ki taraf arrow par '−' laga hai. Iska matlab kya hai?
options: Price ki wajah se demand zero ho jaati hai
Demand badhne se price badhti hai
Price aur demand ke beech delay hai
Baaki sab same rehte hue, price badhe to demand ghat-ti hai (opposite direction)
questions.explanation: − polarity ka matlab opposite direction ka change hai: cause badhe to effect ghate, cause ghate to effect badhe. Ye size nahi batata, isliye 'zero ho jaati hai' galat hai. Arrow ki direction price se demand ki taraf hai, ulta nahi, aur delay ke liye || mark lagta hai.

questions.question: Ek company ki sales girti hain to woh har baar bada discount de deti hai, product improve karne ki jagah. Dheere-dheere customers discount ka intezaar karne lagte hain, margins girte hain aur R&D budget bhi kat jaata hai. Kaunsa archetype hai?
questions.explanation: Discount symptomatic quick fix hai, product improvement fundamental solution. Quick fix par dependence badhi (customers discount ka wait karte hain) aur fundamental solution kamzor hua (R&D kata): ye shifting the burden hai. Escalation tab hota jab do competitors ek doosre ke discount ka jawab de rahe hote.

questions.question: Ek food delivery startup ke orders tezi se badh rahe the. Rider fleet utni hi rahi, delivery time badhne laga, ratings giri aur growth ruk gayi. Archetype ke hisaab se sabse effective leverage kya hai?
options: Growth waapas laane ke liye ads par aur kharch karna
Prices aur ghataana taaki aur orders aayein
Limiting factor (rider capacity) ko pehle dheela karna, phir growth push karna
Ratings ko ignore karna kyunki woh temporary hain
questions.explanation: Ye limits to growth hai: reinforcing growth loop ek capacity limit (riders) se takraaya. Ads ya price cut growth engine ko aur dhakelte hain, jisse delivery time aur badhega aur balancing loop aur strong hoga. Leverage limit par hai: riders badhao ya order zones ko capacity ke hisaab se kholo.

questions.question: Ek municipality traffic jam kam karne ke liye ek road chaudi karti hai. Ek-do saal mein road aasaan hone ki wajah se zyada log car se jaane lagte hain aur jam waapas aa jaata hai. Ye kaunsa archetype hai?
questions.explanation: Fix (chaudi road) ne symptom (jam) ko abhi kam kiya, par delay ke baad uske unintended consequence (zyada log car chalaane lage) ne wahi problem waapas la di: ye fixes that fail hai. Tragedy of the commons trap hai kyunki road shared hai, par kahani fix ke ulta padne ki hai, resource ke collapse ki nahi.

questions.question: Ek logistics team ka on-time delivery target 98% hai, par woh baar-baar miss hota hai. Process theek karne ke bajaye management target pehle 95% aur phir 90% kar deti hai. Kaunsa archetype hai aur leverage kya hai?
options: Eroding goals; standard ko hold karo aur actual performance sudhaar kar gap band karo
Limits to growth; deliveries aur badhao
Tragedy of the commons; shared trucks par quota lagao
questions.explanation: Gap band karne ke liye performance sudhaarne ki jagah goal ko hi neeche karna eroding goals hai; isse standards dheere-dheere girte jaate hain. Leverage goal ko hold karna aur process ka asli kaam karna hai. Limits to growth trap hai kyunki performance ek limit par atki lagti hai, par yahan kahani goal ko neeche khisakaane ki hai, growth ki nahi.

questions.question: Ek chauraahe par aamne-saamne do petrol pumps hain. Ek ne free air check aur car wash shuru kiya, doosre ne car wash ke saath discount diya, phir pehle ne aur bada offer diya, aur dono ka margin girta gaya. Kaunsa archetype hai?
questions.explanation: Do parties ek doosre ke action ko threat maan kar har baar aur bada jawab deti hain: ye escalation hai, jaise price war. Fixes that fail mein ek hi actor ka fix baad mein ulta padta hai, aur eroding goals mein goal neeche khisakta hai; yahan kahani do competitors ke aapas mein react karne ki hai.

questions.question: Ek company ki do sales teams mein se jis team ne pehle quarter mein zyada sale ki, use agle quarter zyada leads aur budget diye gaye. Woh aur aage nikal gayi, aur doosri team kam resources ke saath aur pichhe reh gayi. Kaunsa archetype hai?
questions.explanation: Jo pehle jeeta use zyada resources milte hain, jisse woh aur jeet-ta hai aur doosra pichhe reh jaata hai: success to the successful. Tragedy of the commons trap hai kyunki dono teams ek shared budget se le rahi hain, par wahan sab users milkar resource ko khatam karte hain; yahan resource ek winner ki taraf jhuk raha hai.

questions.question: Causal loop diagram mein inme se kaunsa variable name sabse sahi tareeke se likha gaya hai?
questions.explanation: CLD mein variables neutral quantities hone chahiye jo badh ya ghat sakein, taaki + aur − ka matlab saaf rahe. 'Number of staff' aisi quantity hai. 'Hire more staff' aur 'Increase sales quickly' actions hain, aur 'Better quality' mein direction pehle se jud gayi hai; sahi naam 'Quality' hota.

questions.question: Ek CLD mein 'Training → Skill level' arrow par || ka mark bana hai. Iska matlab kya hai?
options: Asar aane mein time lagta hai (delay)
Poora loop balancing ban jaata hai
Dono variables ka koi rishta nahi hai
questions.explanation: Arrow par do lakeerein (||) delay dikhaati hain: training aaj ho, to skill badhne mein hafte ya mahine lagte hain. Polarity + ya − se dikhti hai, || se nahi. Loop ka type negative links ki ginti se tay hota hai, delay se nahi, isliye 'balancing ban jaata hai' bhi galat hai.

questions.question: Ek office building ki shared parking mein har company apne zyada se zyada employees ko car laane deti hai, kyunki 'hamari kuch extra cars se kya farq padega'. Ab kisi ko jagah nahi milti. Archetype ke hisaab se sabse achha leverage kya hai?
options: Har company ka parking quota aur monitoring
Sab companies ko aur cars laane do
Ignore karo, kuch time mein apne aap theek hoga
Sabse badi company ko poori parking do
questions.explanation: Ye tragedy of the commons hai: shared resource, har user ka individual fayda, aur cost sab par. Leverage shared rules, quotas aur monitoring hai, jaisa Ostrom ne dikhaya ki users milkar rules bana sakte hain. Aur cars laana overuse badhaata hai, ignore karna collapse ko rokta nahi, aur ek company ko sab dena baaki users ke saath unfair hai aur conflict laata hai.

questions.question: Ek factory cost bachaane ke liye sasta raw material lene lagti hai. Kuch mahine baad defects aur returns itne badh jaate hain ki total cost pehle se bhi zyada ho jaati hai. Kahani mein koi alag 'fundamental solution' neglect nahi hua. Kaunsa archetype hai?
options: Shifting the burden: sasta material ek quick fix hai
Limits to growth: cost ek limiting factor ban gaya
Fixes that fail: fix ka side-effect cost badhaata hai
Escalation: suppliers aapas mein price war kar rahe
questions.explanation: Fix (sasta material) ne symptom (high cost) ko abhi theek kiya, par delay ke baad uska unintended consequence (defects, returns) wahi problem aur badha laaya: fixes that fail. Shifting the burden sabse tempting trap hai, par usme ek alag fundamental solution hota hai jo quick fix ki wajah se kamzor padta hai; sawaal saaf kehta hai ki aisa kuch nahi hai. Yahan koi growth ya do competitors ki ladaai nahi hai.

questions.question: Loop: customers → (+) server load → (−) app speed → (+) customer satisfaction → (+) customers. Ye kaunsa loop hai, aur limits to growth archetype mein iska role kya hai?
options: Balancing (1 negative link); growth ko rokne wala limiting loop
Balancing (2 negative links); fixes that fail ka loop
Reinforcing (0 negative links); success to the successful
questions.explanation: Negative links gino: sirf server load → app speed, yaani 1, jo odd hai, isliye balancing. Trace: customers badhe → load badha → speed giri → satisfaction giri → customers ghate: ye growth ka virodh karta hai. Limits to growth mein yahi limiting balancing loop hai, jabki word of mouth wala reinforcing loop growth engine hota hai. Server capacity is loop ka limiting factor hai.

questions.question: Ek school ka board exam pass target 90% hai, par result 75% aata hai. Teen options: (P) agle saal ka target hi 75% kar do, (Q) remedial classes aur teacher training shuru karo, (R) internal tests ki checking lenient kar do taaki numbers achhe dikhein. Systems thinking ke hisaab se sahi analysis kya hai?
options: P aur Q symptomatic hain; R leverage hai
Q aur R symptomatic hain; P leverage hai
P symptomatic hai; Q aur R dono leverage hain
P aur R standard girate hain; Q leverage hai
questions.explanation: P seedha eroding goals hai: gap band karne ke liye goal neeche kar diya. R bhi standard girata hai: performance sudhre bina numbers achhe dikhte hain, jo ek symptomatic fix hai. Q actual performance par kaam karta hai aur goal ko hold karta hai, isliye leverage hai. Jo options P ya R ko leverage maante hain, woh asal mein standard girane ko hi solution bana dete hain.

questions.question: Ek manager team ki har urgent problem khud solve kar deta hai. Team kabhi khud solve karna nahi seekhti, manager ke bina kuch nahi hota, aur ab manager ke paas strategy ke liye time hi nahi bacha. Kaunsa archetype hai, aur uska side-effect kya hai?
options: Fixes that fail; fix se costs waapas badh gaye
Shifting the burden; team ki manager par dependence
Tragedy of the commons; manager ek shared resource hai
Escalation; manager aur team ek doosre se lad rahe
questions.explanation: Manager ka khud solve karna symptomatic quick fix hai; fundamental solution team ki capability banana (training, delegation) hai, jo delay ke saath kaam karta hai aur neglect ho gaya. Side-effect: team ki manager par dependence badhi, jo is archetype ka classic sign hai. Tragedy of the commons trap hai kyunki manager ka time sab use karte hain, par kahani overuse se collapse ki nahi, quick fix par dependence ki hai.

weeks.title: Inquiring Systems and Soft vs Hard Approaches
weeks.summary: Is week aap seekhoge ki managers 'sach' kaise tay karte hain: Churchman ke paanch inquiring systems (Leibnizian, Lockean, Kantian, Hegelian, Singerian), hard aur soft systems approaches ka fark, Checkland ki soft systems methodology aur CATWOE, aur Ackoff ke problem ko treat karne ke chaar tareeke.
concepts: **Ways of knowing**: Har decision ke peeche ek sawaal hai: 'hum kaise jaante hain ki ye sahi hai?' Kabhi logic se, kabhi data se, kabhi alag models compare karke, kabhi debate se. C. West Churchman ne 'The Design of Inquiring Systems' (1971) mein paanch archetypal inquiring systems bataaye, har ek ek philosopher ke naam par. Inhe ek-doosre ka replacement nahi, alag situations ke tools samjho.

**Leibnizian inquiry**: Formal aur deductive. Kuch basic assumptions (axioms) se shuru karke logic se conclusions nikaalte hain; 'sach' wahi jo model ke andar consistent ho. Example: ek financial model ya optimisation formula. Strength: rigour. Weakness: agar starting assumptions galat hain to poora model galat, aur model khud ise pakad nahi paata.

**Lockean inquiry**: Empirical aur inductive. Observations aur data se shuru karte hain, aur 'sach' woh hai jis par observers ki community agree kare (consensus). Example: customer survey ke results par team ka agreement. Weakness: sab ek hi galat cheez par agree kar sakte hain, aur ye maan leta hai ki data apne aap mein saaf hai.

**Kantian inquiry**: Theory aur data dono saath. Same problem ke kai alternative models ya representations banaaye jaate hain, aur dekha jaata hai kaunsa data ko sabse achhe se explain karta hai. Example: demand ka forecast teen alag models se banana aur compare karna. Moderately unstructured problems ke liye achha.

**Hegelian (dialectical) inquiry**: Same data se do strong opposing views (thesis aur antithesis) banaaye jaate hain aur unhe takraaya jaata hai; conflict se hidden assumptions saamne aati hain aur ek behtar **synthesis** banta hai. Example: 'expand karo' vs 'consolidate karo' plans ka structured debate. Wicked, strategic problems ke liye useful.

**Singerian inquiry**: Pragmatic aur open-ended. Inquiry kabhi poori khatam nahi hoti; measurements aur models lagaataar refine hote hain, aur naye variables, doosre disciplines aur ethics ko bhi 'sweep in' kiya jaata hai. Sawaal sirf 'kya sach hai' nahi, 'kiske liye aur kis goal ke liye' bhi hai. Learning organisation ki soch isse milti hai.

**Hard vs soft systems**: **Hard systems approach** (systems engineering, operations research) maanta hai ki goal clear aur agreed hai; kaam hai best tareeka dhoondhna (optimise karna). **Soft systems approach** un 'messy' situations ke liye hai jahan stakeholders ke goals aur worldviews alag hain aur problem khud hi disputed hai. Peter Checkland ki **soft systems methodology (SSM)**: rich picture banao, relevant systems ki **root definitions** likho (**CATWOE**: customers, actors, transformation, Weltanschauung yaani worldview, owners, environmental constraints), conceptual models banao, real world se compare karo, aur feasible aur desirable changes par agree karo.

**Ackoff ke chaar tareeke**: Russell Ackoff ne kaha ki managers aksar alag problems nahi, aapas mein jude problems ka 'mess' face karte hain. Problem treat karne ke tareeke: **absolve** (ignore karke ummeed ki khud theek ho jaaye), **resolve** (experience aur common sense se 'good enough' jawab), **solve** (research aur models se optimal jawab) aur **dissolve** (system ko redesign kar do taaki problem paida hi na ho). Ackoff ke hisaab se dissolve sabse powerful hai.

example.problem: 'Vidya Institute' (fictional) ki canteen par students long queues ki, staff kam margin ki, aur management hygiene ki shikaayat karta hai. Har group problem alag dekhta hai. SSM ke liye ek root definition ka CATWOE likho, jahan system ka kaam hai 'students ko lunch break mein jaldi, saaf aur affordable khaana dena'.
steps: C (customers, jinhe transformation ka fayda ya nuksaan): students aur staff jo canteen mein khaate hain.
A (actors, jo transformation karte hain): canteen contractor aur uske workers.
T (transformation): bhookhe students, jinhe lunch break mein khaana chahiye → students jinhe time par saaf, affordable khaana mil gaya.
W (worldview): 'achha canteen padhai ke din ka zaroori hissa hai, sirf ek business nahi.'
O (owners, jo system ko rok ya badal sakte hain): institute management.
E (environmental constraints): fixed lunch break, food safety rules, limited kitchen space, contractor ka margin.
Doosre worldview (jaise contractor ka 'canteen ek business hai') se doosri root definition banegi; SSM in dono ko compare karke aisi changes dhoondhta hai jo sab ke liye feasible aur desirable hon.
Answer: CATWOE se **alag worldviews saaf ho jaate hain**, jisse agreed improvements par baat ho sakti hai.

mistakes: Hegelian aur Kantian ko same samajhna. Kantian mein kai complementary models fit ke liye compare hote hain; Hegelian mein do **opposing** views jaan-boojh kar takraaye jaate hain.
Har problem par hard systems approach lagaana. Jab stakeholders goal par hi agree nahi hain, to optimisation se pehle soft approach se problem samajhna padta hai.
CATWOE mein 'W' ko workers samajhna. W = Weltanschauung, yaani woh worldview jisse transformation meaningful lagta hai; workers actors (A) hain.
revision: Leibnizian: logic se, internal consistency.
Lockean: data aur community ka consensus.
Kantian: kai models, best fit.
Hegelian: thesis vs antithesis → synthesis.
Singerian: open-ended, sweep in ethics aur naye variables.
Hard = clear goal, optimise; soft = messy, multiple worldviews (SSM, CATWOE). Ackoff: absolve, resolve, solve, dissolve.

questions.question: Ek strategy team same market data se do jaan-boojh kar opposing plans banati hai ('aggressive expansion' vs 'consolidation'), unka structured debate karwaati hai, aur debate se nikli insights se ek naya combined plan banaati hai. Churchman ke hisaab se ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Same data se thesis aur antithesis banakar takraana aur synthesis nikaalna Hegelian (dialectical) inquiry hai. Kantian trap hai: usme bhi kai models hote hain, par woh complementary hote hain aur best fit ke liye compare hote hain, jaan-boojh kar opposing nahi.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsi situation hard systems approach ke liye sabse suitable hai?
options: Fixed routes aur known demand ke saath delivery cost minimise karna
Shehar ki development priorities par stakeholders ke beech jhagda suljhaana
Ek university ka culture redesign karna
Ek hospital ka purpose kya ho, is par disagreement
questions.explanation: Hard systems approach tab kaam karta hai jab goal clear aur agreed ho aur problem well-defined ho; delivery cost minimise karna ek classic optimisation problem hai. Baaki teeno mein stakeholders ke goals aur worldviews hi alag hain, jo soft systems approach ka area hai.

questions.question: Checkland ki soft systems methodology mein CATWOE ka 'W' kya hai?
options: Weltanschauung: woh worldview jisse transformation meaningful lagta hai
Wastage jo process mein hoti hai
questions.explanation: W = Weltanschauung (German shabd, matlab worldview): woh perspective jisme ye transformation sense banata hai. Alag worldviews se alag root definitions bante hain, aur SSM inhi ko compare karta hai. Workers trap hai, kyunki jo log transformation karte hain woh 'A' (actors) mein aate hain.

questions.question: Ek marketing team 2,000 customers ka survey karti hai aur jis baat par data aur poori team agree karti hai, use 'customer ki asli pasand' maan leti hai. Ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Observations (survey data) se shuru karna aur community ke consensus ko 'sach' maanna Lockean inquiry hai. Leibnizian trap hai kyunki dono 'systematic' lagte hain, par Leibnizian data se nahi, assumptions aur logic se conclusion nikaalta hai.

questions.question: Ek factory canteen mein dopahar 1 baje bahut bheed hoti hai. Ackoff ke chaar tareekon mein se kaunsa option problem ko 'dissolve' karna hai?
options: Kuch na karna aur ummeed karna ki bheed apne aap kam ho jaayegi
Pichhli baar ki tarah ek extra counter khol dena
Queueing model se counters ki optimal sankhya nikaalna
Departments ke lunch timings stagger kar dena taaki bheed bane hi nahi
questions.explanation: Dissolve ka matlab system ko aise redesign karna ki problem paida hi na ho; staggered lunch timings se 1 baje ki peak hi khatam ho jaati hai. Kuch na karna absolve hai, experience se extra counter resolve hai, aur queueing model se optimum nikaalna solve hai. Trap: solve, kyunki woh sabse 'scientific' lagta hai, par woh bheed ko accept karke usse deal karta hai.

questions.question: Ek forecasting team agle saal ki demand ke liye teen alag models banati hai (time-series trend, GDP par regression, aur expert panel), teeno ko same past data par test karti hai, aur woh model chunti hai jo data ko sabse achhe se explain kare. Ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Same problem ke kai alternative models banana aur unme se best fit chunna Kantian inquiry hai, jo theory aur data dono ko saath laati hai. Hegelian sabse tempting trap hai, par usme views jaan-boojh kar opposing hote hain aur debate se synthesis banta hai; yahan models compete karte hain, takraate nahi. Lockean sirf data aur consensus par chalta, alag theories par nahi.

questions.question: Ek analyst kuch fixed assumptions (demand constant, price constant, cost formula diya hua) se shuru karke maths se 'optimal' production quantity nikaalta hai, bina koi naya data dekhe. Churchman ke hisaab se ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Assumptions (axioms) se logic aur formula ke through conclusion nikaalna Leibnizian inquiry hai; 'sach' wahi jo model ke andar consistent ho. Lockean data aur consensus se chalta hai, jo yahan nahi hai. Weakness yaad rakho: agar assumptions galat hain to model ka 'optimal' bhi galat hoga.

questions.question: Ek manager office printer ke baar-baar jam hone ki problem ko ignore karta hai aur sochta hai ki ye apne aap theek ho jaayegi. Ackoff ke hisaab se ye problem ko treat karne ka kaunsa tareeka hai?
questions.explanation: Problem ko ignore karke ummeed karna ki woh khud theek ho jaaye, absolve hai. Resolve experience se 'good enough' jawab hai, solve research se optimal jawab, aur dissolve system ko redesign karke problem khatam karna. Trap: dissolve, kyunki dono mein problem 'gaayab' hone ki baat hai; par dissolve mein redesign hota hai, absolve mein kuch nahi.

questions.question: Checkland ki soft systems methodology mein CATWOE ka 'A' kya hai?
options: Assumptions: jo plan ke peeche hain
Authority: jo final decision leta hai
questions.explanation: A = actors, yaani woh log jo transformation ko actually karte hain (jaise canteen ke workers). Final decision lene ya system ko rokne ki power owners (O) ke paas hoti hai, isliye 'authority' wala option O se confuse karta hai. Assumptions aur analysis CATWOE ke letters hi nahi hain.

questions.question: Ek city planning team apne air pollution model ko har saal naye data, health experts ki raay aur ethics ke sawaalon ('kiske liye safe?') ke saath refine karti rehti hai, aur maanti hai ki inquiry kabhi 'final' nahi hogi. Ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Open-ended inquiry jo lagaataar refine hoti hai, doosre disciplines aur ethics ko 'sweep in' karti hai, aur 'kiske liye' poochti hai, Singerian hai. Kantian trap hai, kyunki usme bhi models aur data hain; par Kantian kai models compare karke best fit chunta hai aur ruk jaata hai, jabki yahan inquiry kabhi khatam nahi hoti.

questions.question: Ek warehouse manager apne 15 saal ke experience se kehta hai: 'Peak season mein 10 temporary workers rakh lo, hamesha kaam chal jaata hai.' Woh koi model ya data analysis nahi karta. Ackoff ke hisaab se ye kaunsa tareeka hai?
questions.explanation: Experience aur common sense se ek 'good enough' jawab dena resolve hai. Solve tab hota jab woh data aur models se optimal number nikaalta. Absolve kuch na karna hai, aur dissolve system ko aise redesign karna ki peak problem hi na bane (jaise orders ko saal bhar spread karna).

questions.question: Ek company ke 5 senior managers ek market survey report par poori tarah agree karte hain aur use 'customer ki asli pasand' maan kar ek bada launch kar dete hain. Launch fail hota hai, aur pata chalta hai ki survey sirf metro cities mein hua tha. Kaunse inquiring system ki kaunsi weakness yahan dikhti hai?
options: Lockean: sab ek galat data par bhi agree kar sakte hain
Leibnizian: model ke starting axioms hi galat the
Hegelian: opposing plans ka debate nahi hua
Singerian: inquiry kabhi khatam hi nahi hoti
questions.explanation: Step 1: team ne data (survey) aur apne consensus ko 'sach' maana, jo Lockean inquiry hai. Step 2: Lockean ki weakness ye hai ki community ek galat ya biased data par bhi agree kar sakti hai, aur ye maan leta hai ki data apne aap saaf hai; yahan sample sirf metro ka tha. Leibnizian assumptions-se-logic wala system hai, jo yahan use nahi hua. Hegelian debate shayad madad karta, par sawaal us system ki weakness ka hai jo actually use hua.

questions.question: SSM root definition: 'Municipality ke owned ek system jo contractor ki teams ke through city residents ka kachra ikattha karke recycle karta hai, is belief ke saath ki saaf shehar har nagrik ka haq hai, budget aur pollution laws ke andar.' Isme 'contractor ki teams' aur 'saaf shehar har nagrik ka haq hai' CATWOE ke kramashah kaunse elements hain?
questions.explanation: Contractor ki teams transformation (kachra ikattha aur recycle) ko actually karti hain, isliye actors (A). 'Saaf shehar har nagrik ka haq hai' woh worldview hai jisse ye transformation meaningful lagta hai: Weltanschauung (W). Customers residents hain aur owners municipality. Trap: belief ko transformation maanna; T input ka output mein badalna hai (kachra wala shehar → saaf, recycled), belief nahi.

questions.question: Ek company ke saamne teen kaam hain: (1) diye hue formula se loan ki EMI nikaalna, (2) naye product ki demand ke liye kai forecasting models banakar compare karna aur best fit chunna, (3) 'competitor ko acquire karo ya nahi' par do opposing teams ka debate karwa kar synthesis nikaalna. Kramashah sabse suitable inquiring systems kaunse hain?
questions.explanation: (1) Fixed formula se deduction: Leibnizian, jo well-structured problem ke liye perfect hai. (2) Kai alternative models aur data par best fit: Kantian. (3) Thesis vs antithesis se synthesis: Hegelian. Doosra option (2) ko Lockean kehta hai, par Lockean ek data set par consensus hai, alag models ka comparison nahi. Lesson: inquiring systems ek doosre ke replacement nahi, alag problems ke tools hain.

questions.question: Ek university mein exams ke time library seats ki kami hai, aur students, faculty aur admin is problem ko bilkul alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Ek consultant pehle rich picture aur har group ke worldview ki root definitions banata hai. End mein woh suggest karta hai ki departments ke exams stagger kar do taaki sabke exams ek saath na hon aur seat crunch bane hi nahi. Approach aur Ackoff ka tareeka kramashah kya hain?
questions.explanation: Step 1: stakeholders ke worldviews alag hain aur consultant rich picture aur root definitions use karta hai: ye soft systems approach (SSM) hai. Step 2: exam schedule redesign karke peak demand hi khatam karna dissolve hai. Resolve tab hota jab experience se kuch temporary seats jod di jaatin, aur solve tab jab ek model se seats ki optimal sankhya nikaali jaati. Hard systems agreed goal maanta hai, jo yahan nahi hai.

weeks.title: Integrative Management: Strategy, Structure, Culture and Responsibility
weeks.summary: Is week aap seekhoge ki strategy, structure aur culture ko ek saath fit kaise karte hain (Porter, Chandler, Schein, McKinsey 7S), change kaise manage hota hai, aur business ethics, CSR (India ka Section 135) aur sustainability ka role kya hai.
concepts: **Strategy**: Long-term direction aur competitive advantage paane ka plan. Levels: **corporate** (kaunse businesses mein rahein), **business** (ek market mein kaise compete karein) aur **functional** (marketing, operations jaise departments ka plan). Michael Porter ki **generic strategies**: **cost leadership** (industry mein sabse kam cost), **differentiation** (kuch unique jiske liye customer zyada de) aur **focus** (ek narrow segment par cost ya differentiation). Bina clear choice ke company 'stuck in the middle' ho sakti hai.

**Structure follows strategy**: Alfred Chandler ne 'Strategy and Structure' (1962) mein bade American firms ko study karke dikhaya ki jab strategy badalti hai (jaise diversification), tab structure ko bhi badalna padta hai. Ek product wali company ke liye **functional** structure theek hai; kai products ya regions wali company ke liye **divisional**; dono dimensions ek saath manage karne ke liye **matrix** (jisme unity of command tootta hai).

**Organisational culture (Edgar Schein)**: Teen levels: **artifacts** (dikhne wali cheezein: office layout, dress code, rituals), **espoused values** (jo company kehti hai ki woh maanti hai: mission statements, stated values) aur **basic underlying assumptions** (gehri, unspoken beliefs jo asli behaviour chalaati hain). Culture badalna mushkil hai kyunki asli culture sabse neeche wale level mein hota hai.

**McKinsey 7S framework**: Saat elements jo aapas mein fit hone chahiye: hard S (strategy, structure, systems) aur soft S (shared values, style, staff, skills); shared values centre mein. Strategy badlo par systems (incentives, processes) aur style (leadership) purane rahein to strategy fail hoti hai.

**Managing change**: Kurt Lewin ka model: **unfreeze** (change ki zaroorat samjhao, purani aadatein dheeli karo), **change** (naye tareeke laao, training, support) aur **refreeze** (naye behaviour ko systems, rewards aur norms se pakka karo). Resistance aam baat hai; communication aur participation se kam hota hai.

**Business ethics**: Decisions ko sirf 'legal hai?' se nahi, 'sahi hai?' se bhi judge karna. Approaches: **utilitarian** (sabse zyada logon ka sabse zyada fayda), **rights** (har insaan ke basic rights ka respect) aur **justice** (fair aur barabar treatment). Code of conduct, ethics training aur whistleblower protection ethical culture banaate hain.

**CSR**: Archie Carroll ka **CSR pyramid**: economic (profitable hona), legal (kaanoon maanna), ethical (kaanoon se aage jaakar sahi aur fair karna) aur philanthropic (community ke liye voluntary contribution). India mein Companies Act, 2013 ka **Section 135**: jin companies ki net worth ₹500 crore ya zyada, ya turnover ₹1,000 crore ya zyada, ya net profit ₹5 crore ya zyada ho, unhe pichhle 3 financial years ke average net profit ka kam se kam 2% CSR par kharch karna hota hai.

**Sustainability**: John Elkington ka **triple bottom line**: people, planet, profit; performance teeno par naapo. Aaj investors **ESG** (environmental, social, governance) metrics dekhte hain. Idea: long-term value tab banti hai jab business society aur environment ki keemat par nahi, unke saath grow kare.

example.problem: 'Godavari Cements' (fictional) Section 135 ke under aati hai. Pichhle teen financial years mein uska net profit ₹120 crore, ₹150 crore aur ₹180 crore tha. Is saal kam se kam kitna CSR kharch zaroori hai?
steps: Rule: pichhle 3 financial years ke average net profit ka 2%.
Average = 450 ÷ 3 = ₹150 crore.
Common galti: sirf latest year (180) ka 2% = ₹3.6 crore lena, ya teeno ke total ka 2% = ₹9 crore.
Answer: Kam se kam **₹3 crore** CSR par kharch karna hoga.

mistakes: Ethical aur philanthropic responsibility mix karna. Ethical = apne business ko fair tareeke se chalaana, chahe kaanoon na maange (jaise poori product information dena). Philanthropic = voluntary daan aur community programmes (jaise school banwaana).
Ye maanna ki nayi strategy announce karna kaafi hai. 7S ke hisaab se structure, systems, style aur skills bhi fit na hon to strategy kaagaz par reh jaati hai.
CSR ka 2% latest year ke profit par lagaana. Base pichhle teen years ka average net profit hai.
revision: Porter: cost leadership, differentiation, focus.
Chandler: structure follows strategy.
Schein: artifacts, espoused values, basic assumptions.
7S: strategy, structure, systems, shared values, style, staff, skills.
Lewin: unfreeze, change, refreeze.
Carroll: economic, legal, ethical, philanthropic. Section 135: average net profit (3 years) ka 2%.

questions.question: 'UdaanSasta Air' (fictional) sirf ek type ka aircraft use karti hai, free meals nahi deti, tickets sirf online bechti hai aur planes ka turnaround time kam rakhti hai, taaki fares industry mein sabse kam hon. Porter ke hisaab se ye kaunsi strategy hai?
questions.explanation: Har activity ko sabse kam cost ke liye design karna aur broad market ko sabse sasta offer dena cost leadership hai. Differentiation mein customer kisi unique feature ke liye zyada price deta, jo yahan nahi hai. Focus tab hota jab airline sirf ek narrow segment ko target karti.

questions.question: Ek startup ka open-plan office, bean bags, casual dress code aur Friday team lunches Schein ke model mein culture ke kis level par hain?
questions.explanation: Jo cheezein aankh se dikhti hain (layout, dress code, rituals) woh artifacts hain, culture ka sabse upari level. Inka matlab samajhne ke liye gehre levels dekhne padte hain. Espoused values trap hai: woh likhe ya bole gaye values hain (jaise 'we value openness'), physical cheezein nahi.

questions.question: Ek company Section 135 ke under aati hai. Pichhle teen financial years mein uska net profit ₹40 crore, ₹50 crore aur ₹90 crore tha. Is saal kam se kam kitna CSR kharch zaroori hai?
questions.explanation: Average net profit = (40 + 50 + 90) ÷ 3 = 180 ÷ 3 = ₹60 crore. CSR = 2% × 60 = ₹1.2 crore. ₹1.8 crore latest year (90) ka 2% hai, ₹3.6 crore teeno ke total (180) ka 2%, aur ₹1 crore beech wale year (50) ka 2%.

questions.question: 'Triveni Group' (fictional) pehle sirf soap banaati thi aur functional structure (ek production head, ek marketing head) mein chalti thi. Ab woh FMCG, hotels aur IT services mein diversify ho gayi hai aur decisions bahut slow ho gaye hain. Chandler kya suggest karte?
options: Functional structure hi rakho, kyunki structure kabhi nahi badalna chahiye
Divisional structure apnao, kyunki structure ko nayi strategy ke hisaab se badalna chahiye
Strategy ko purane structure ke hisaab se badlo
Saare decisions CEO ke paas centralise kar do
questions.explanation: Chandler ka finding tha ki structure strategy ko follow karta hai: diversification ke baad har business ke liye alag division (apne production, marketing ke saath) zyada effective hota hai. Teesra option relationship ko ulta kar deta hai, aur centralisation slow decisions ko aur slow karega.

questions.question: Ek bank nayi strategy announce karta hai: 'customer-centric innovation'. Par approvals ke liye ab bhi 7 signatures chahiye, managers ke bonus sirf cost-cutting par milte hain, aur top leadership ka style command-and-control hai. McKinsey 7S ke hisaab se diagnosis kya hai?
options: Sirf strategy matter karti hai, isliye sab theek hai
Misfit hai: systems, style aur shared values nayi strategy ko support nahi karte
Problem sirf staff ki sankhya ki hai
7S sirf chhoti companies par lagta hai
questions.explanation: 7S kehta hai ki saat elements ek doosre se fit hone chahiye. Approval process aur bonus systems hain, command style 'style' hai, aur ye teeno innovation ke khilaaf kaam kar rahe hain. Strategy akeli kaagaz par badli hai, isliye result nahi aayega. Staff count ka yahan koi zikr hi nahi.

questions.question: Ek pharma company saare pollution aur drug laws follow karti hai. Iske alawa woh apni dawa ke saare side-effect data publicly share karti hai, jabki kaanoon itna nahi maangta, kyunki patients ke saath ye fair hai. Carroll ke pyramid mein ye extra kadam kis level par hai?
questions.explanation: Kaanoon se aage jaakar apne core business ko fair aur sahi tareeke se chalaana ethical responsibility hai. Laws follow karna legal level hai, jo company pehle se kar rahi hai. Philanthropic sabse tempting trap hai, par woh voluntary daan aur community programmes (jaise hospital ko donation) ke baare mein hai, apne product ki honest jaankari dene ke baare mein nahi.

questions.question: Ek premium headphones brand apni unique sound quality aur design ki wajah se competitors se 40% zyada price leta hai, aur customers khushi se dete hain. Porter ki kaunsi generic strategy hai?
questions.explanation: Kuch unique dena jiske liye customer zyada price de, differentiation hai. Cost leadership mein company sabse kam cost aur price par compete karti hai, jo yahan ulta hai. Stuck in the middle tab hota jab company na sabse sasti hoti na unique, jabki yahan choice saaf hai.

questions.question: Naye software ke rollout se pehle CEO ek town hall mein data dikhata hai ki purana system har mahine kitne orders kho raha hai, taaki sab log change ki zaroorat samjhein. Lewin ke model ka ye kaunsa stage hai?
questions.explanation: Change ki zaroorat samjhaana aur purani aadatein dheeli karna unfreeze stage hai. Change stage mein naye tareeke actually laaye jaate hain (training, rollout), aur refreeze mein naye behaviour ko systems aur rewards se pakka kiya jaata hai. Feedback Lewin ke teen stages mein nahi hai.

questions.question: Ek company apne profit se ek gaon mein library banwaati hai. Ye kisi kaanoon ki requirement nahi hai aur company ke business se bhi juda nahi hai. Carroll ke CSR pyramid mein ye kaunsa level hai?
questions.explanation: Community ke liye voluntary contribution, jo kaanoon nahi maangta aur core business se juda nahi, philanthropic responsibility hai. Ethical level apne business ko fair tareeke se chalaane ke baare mein hai. Trap: ethical, kyunki library banwaana 'achha kaam' hai; par woh daan hai, business ka fair conduct nahi.

questions.question: Pichhle financial year mein ek company ki net worth ₹300 crore, turnover ₹800 crore aur net profit ₹6 crore tha. Kya Section 135 ke CSR rules is company par lagenge?
options: Nahi, kyunki uski net worth ₹500 crore se kam hai
Haan, kyunki net profit ₹5 crore ki limit se upar hai
Nahi, kyunki teeno conditions ek saath poori honi chahiye
Nahi, kyunki uska turnover ₹1,000 crore se kam hai
questions.explanation: Section 135 tab lagta hai jab teen mein se koi ek condition poori ho: net worth ₹500 crore ya zyada, ya turnover ₹1,000 crore ya zyada, ya net profit ₹5 crore ya zyada. Net profit ₹6 crore hai, jo ₹5 crore se zyada hai, isliye rules lagenge. Sabse bada trap 'teeno conditions saath chahiye' hai; ye 'ya' wala rule hai, 'aur' wala nahi. Net worth aur turnover wale options ek condition fail dekh kar ruk jaate hain.

questions.question: Ek company ki website par likha hai 'We value work-life balance'. Par sab jaante hain ki jo raat 11 baje tak online nahi dikhta uska promotion nahi hota, aur ye baat koi khul kar nahi bolta. Schein ke model mein 'der raat tak online rehna hi asli commitment hai' wali soch kis level par hai?
options: Artifacts, jo bahar se dikhte hain
Espoused values, jo company kehti hai
questions.explanation: Gehri, unspoken belief jo asli behaviour (promotions) chalaati hai, basic underlying assumption hai. Website wala 'We value work-life balance' espoused value hai, yaani jo company kehti hai. Trap: espoused values, kyunki sawaal values ki baat karta hai; par asli culture neeche wale level par hai, jo stated value ke ulta hai.

questions.question: Ek company Section 135 ke under aati hai. Pichhle teen financial years mein uska net profit ₹80 crore, ₹20 crore ka loss, aur ₹100 crore tha. Is saal kam se kam kitna CSR kharch zaroori hai (2 decimal places tak round karke)?
questions.explanation: Average net profit mein loss negative gina jaata hai: (80 − 20 + 100) ÷ 3 = 160 ÷ 3 ≈ ₹53.33 crore. CSR = 2% × 53.33 ≈ ₹1.07 crore. ₹1.2 crore loss ko zero maan kar (80 + 100) ÷ 3 = 60 lene par aata hai, ₹1.8 crore sirf do profitable years ka average (90) lene par, aur ₹2 crore sirf latest year (100) ka 2% hai.

questions.question: 'Dhaaga Fabrics' (fictional) ab tak cost leadership se mass-market ke liye sasta kapda banaati thi. Ab woh premium designer fabrics bhi bechna chahti hai, par usi factory, usi sales team aur usi cost-cutting bonus system ke saath. Sabse bada risk kya hai?
options: Koi risk nahi; dono strategies ek saath aaram se chalti hain
Sirf focus strategy ka risk, kyunki premium market narrow hai
Stuck in the middle, plus 7S misfit: bonus systems aur skills purane
Sirf Lewin ka refreeze stage chhoot jaane ka risk hai
questions.explanation: Porter ke hisaab se bina clear choice ke cost aur differentiation dono chase karne wali company stuck in the middle ho sakti hai. Saath hi 7S lens: nayi strategy (premium) ke saath systems (cost-cutting bonus), skills (mass production team) aur style purane hain, isliye strategy kaagaz par reh jaayegi. Focus wala option sirf ek hissa dekhta hai aur misfit ko ignore karta hai; refreeze toh change ke baad ka stage hai, jo abhi shuru hi nahi hua.

questions.question: Ek manager ko tay karna hai ki ek zaroori dawa ka price kya rakhein. Teen arguments aate hain: (1) 'Woh price rakho jo sabse zyada logon ko sabse zyada fayda de', (2) 'Har patient ka zaroori dawa paane ka basic haq hai', (3) 'Same bimaari wale sab patients se ek jaisa, fair price lo'. Ye kramashah kaunse ethical approaches hain?
questions.explanation: (1) Sabse zyada logon ka sabse zyada fayda: utilitarian. (2) Har insaan ke basic haq ka respect: rights. (3) Fair aur barabar treatment: justice. Teesra option (2) aur (3) ko swap karta hai, jo sabse common trap hai kyunki 'haq' aur 'fair' dono justice jaise lagte hain; farak ye hai ki rights har individual ke haq ki baat karta hai, justice distribution ki fairness ki.

questions.question: Ek company ne naya 'customer-first' process shuru kiya, sabko training di, aur shuru mein log naye tareeke se kaam karne lage. 6 mahine baad sab purane tareeke par laut aaye, kyunki appraisal aur bonus ab bhi sirf calls ki speed par the. Lewin ka kaunsa stage kamzor tha, aur fix kya hai?
