options: Unfreeze; aur zyada town halls karke zaroorat samjhao
Refreeze; appraisal aur rewards ko naye behaviour se jodo
Change; aur zyada training sessions karwao
Koi stage nahi; log hamesha change resist karte hain
questions.explanation: Unfreeze aur change dono hue: log naye tareeke apna chuke the. Problem ye thi ki naya behaviour systems aur rewards se pakka nahi hua, jo refreeze ka kaam hai; purane incentives ne log waapas kheench liye. Ye 7S ka bhi point hai: systems strategy ke saath fit hone chahiye. Aur training trap hai: skill ki kami nahi thi, incentive ka mismatch tha.

weeks.title: Revision: Applying the Whole Course to Mixed Cases
weeks.summary: Is week aap poore course ko ek saath revise karoge: case padh kar sahi thinker, school, function, tool, bias, archetype ya inquiry approach kaise pehchaanein, aur exam ke common traps se kaise bachein.
concepts: **Course map**: Business aur stakeholders (kiske liye manage karte hain) → management thought ka history (kaise soch evolve hui) → management aur business functions (manager kya karta hai, kahan karta hai) → thinking aur tools (achha sochna kaise) → systems thinking (jude hue problems kaise dekhein) → inquiring systems aur soft approaches (sach kaise tay karein) → integration (strategy, structure, culture, ethics).

**Classical aur behavioural clues**: 'Stopwatch, one best way, piece rate' → Taylor. 'Ek boss, scalar chain, 14 principles' → Fayol. 'Written rules, hierarchy, merit, impersonal' → Weber. 'Attention, informal group, social needs' → Mayo/Hawthorne. 'Log kaam se bachte hain vs self-direction' → McGregor. 'Good enough, limited information' → Simon. 'It depends' → contingency. 'Inputs, transformation, outputs, feedback' → systems approach.

**Management function vs business function**: Planning, organising, staffing, leading, controlling **management functions** hain jo har department mein hote hain. Operations, marketing, finance, HR, IS **business (functional) areas** hain. Sawaal mein 'kaunsa kaam' vs 'kaunsa department' ka fark pakdo.

**Bias aur tool clues**: Pehla number → anchoring. Sirf apne favour ka data → confirmation. 'Itna lag chuka hai' → sunk cost. Same fact alag shabdon mein → framing. Group mein koi doubt nahi bolta → groupthink. Root cause chahiye → five whys ya fishbone. Kai causes mein priority → Pareto. Internal vs external → SWOT. Meeting mein ek tarah ki soch → six hats. Existing product badalna → SCAMPER.

**Systems clues**: 'Growth phir achanak ruk gayi' → limits to growth. 'Quick fix baar-baar, asli solution kamzor' → shifting the burden. 'Fix ne baad mein problem badha di' → fixes that fail. 'Shared resource, sab apna fayda' → tragedy of the commons. 'Ek doosre ko jawab' → escalation. 'Goal neeche karte gaye' → eroding goals. 'Upar-neeche jhoolna' → balancing loop with delay. Loop type: negative links gino.

**Inquiry aur approach clues**: Logic/model se → Leibnizian. Data aur consensus → Lockean. Kai models, best fit → Kantian. Opposing plans ka debate → Hegelian. Open-ended, ethics sweep in → Singerian. Clear goal, optimise → hard systems. Conflicting worldviews, messy → soft systems (rich picture, CATWOE). Problem hi khatam karne wala redesign → Ackoff ka dissolve.

**Integration clues**: Sabse sasta → cost leadership; unique → differentiation; narrow segment → focus. Diversification ke baad structure badla → Chandler. Office layout/dress → artifacts. Strategy badli par systems/style nahi → 7S misfit. Kaanoon se aage fair business → ethical; daan → philanthropic. CSR = 3 saal ke average net profit ka 2%.

example.problem: 'Annapurna Foods' (fictional) ka case: (1) naye CEO ne har line par stopwatch se time study karwaayi; (2) packing team ne apna informal output limit rakha taaki koi 'rate-buster' na bane; (3) sales giri to har mahine discount diya gaya, recipe improvement ruk gaya; (4) board ne kaha 'is plant par ₹50 crore lag chuke, isliye band nahi kar sakte'; (5) farmers, NGOs aur company mein ek nayi sourcing policy par bilkul alag views hain. Har point ko course ke concept se jodo.
steps: (1) Time study aur one best way: Taylor ka **scientific management**.
(2) Informal group norm se output cap: **Hawthorne studies** (bank wiring room) ka finding.
(3) Quick fix (discount) se fundamental solution (product improve) kamzor hua: **shifting the burden** archetype.
(4) Past kharch ko future decision ka reason banana: **sunk cost fallacy**; sahi sawaal: 'aage ke costs aur benefits kya hain?'
(5) Conflicting worldviews wali messy situation: **soft systems methodology** (rich picture, alag root definitions with CATWOE), ya opposing proposals ke saath **Hegelian** debate.
Answer: Ek hi company mein classical, behavioural, systems, thinking aur inquiry, **paanchon lenses** ki zaroorat padti hai; course ka core yahi hai ki sahi situation par sahi lens lagao.

mistakes: Keyword dekh kar turant answer chun lena. 'Rules' word ho to har baar Weber nahi; poocho ki sawaal structure ke baare mein hai ya kisi ek boss ke baare mein (Fayol) ya situation ke hisaab se design (contingency).
Archetypes mein sirf kahani ka pehla hissa dekhna. Pura pattern dekho: kya koi fundamental solution kamzor hua (shifting the burden) ya fix ne khud problem waapas laayi (fixes that fail)?
Har problem ko optimisation ki tarah treat karna. Pehle poocho: kya goal par sab agree karte hain? Nahi, to soft approach.
revision: Taylor = efficiency; Fayol = administration; Weber = structure; Mayo = social factors.
Management functions har department mein; business functions departments hain.
Sunk cost ignore karo; anchoring se pehle apna estimate banao.
Loop type: negative links even = R, odd = B.
Hard = clear goal; soft = conflicting worldviews.
Strategy, structure, culture aur ethics ek saath fit hone chahiye.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa thinker aur idea ka pair sahi hai?
options: Fayol: scientific management aur time study
questions.explanation: Differential piece-rate Taylor ke scientific management ka hissa hai. Hawthorne studies Mayo se jude hain, 14 principles Fayol ke hain, aur scientific management Taylor ka hai. Baaki teeno options mein naam aur idea aapas mein swap kiye gaye hain, jo exam ka common trap hai.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa ek business (functional) area hai, management function nahi?
questions.explanation: Marketing ek functional area (department) hai. Planning, organising aur controlling management functions hain jo marketing, finance, HR, sab departments ke andar hote hain. Trap: 'function' shabd dono jagah aata hai, isliye dhyaan do ki sawaal 'kaam' ka hai ya 'area' ka.

questions.question: Ek factory supervisor daily target poora karne par bonus deta hai, par dekhta hai ki workers ka group khud ek output limit maanta hai aur usse zyada karne waale ko taane maarta hai. Kis research ne pehli baar is tarah ke informal group norms ko highlight kiya?
options: Hawthorne studies ka bank wiring room observation
questions.explanation: Hawthorne studies ke bank wiring room mein researchers ne dekha ki group ne khud output norm bana rakha tha aur incentive ke bawajood log usse zyada nahi karte the. Taylor trap hai, kyunki Taylor ne bhi workers ke jaan-boojh kar dheere kaam karne (soldiering) ki baat ki thi, par unka jawab time study aur piece-rate tha, social group ka analysis nahi.

questions.question: Ek shehar mein jab bhi accidents badhte hain, extra traffic police tainaat kar di jaati hai. Kuch time accidents kam hote hain, phir badhte hain, aur road design sudhaarne ka budget har saal kat-ta jaata hai kyunki 'police se kaam chal raha hai'. Kaunsa archetype hai?
questions.explanation: Extra police symptomatic quick fix hai aur road redesign fundamental solution. Quick fix par bharosa badhne se fundamental solution ka budget kat-ta gaya: ye shifting the burden hai. Road shared hai isliye tragedy of the commons tempting lagta hai, par yahan resource ka overuse nahi, quick fix par dependence ki kahani hai.

questions.question: Board meeting mein CFO kehta hai: 'Is plant par ₹50 crore lag chuke hain, isliye ise poora karna hi padega.' Ek director poochti hai: 'Agar hum aaj zero se shuru karte, to kya agle ₹30 crore yahin lagaate?' Director kis bias se bacha rahi hai?
questions.explanation: Director ka sawaal ₹50 crore (jo wapas nahi aa sakta) ko hata kar sirf future ₹30 crore aur unke benefits par decision le jaata hai, jo sunk cost fallacy ka seedha ilaaj hai. Anchoring trap hai kyunki ₹50 crore ek bada number hai, par CFO ka argument number se estimate kheenchne ka nahi, past kharch ko reason banane ka hai.

questions.question: Ek state government parali (stubble) burning kam karna chahti hai. Farmers, agricultural scientists, officials aur shehar ke log is issue ko bilkul alag tareeke se dekhte hain, aur kisi ek objective par agreement nahi hai. Course ke hisaab se sabse suitable approach kya hai?
options: Shuru mein hi ek single cost function ke saath hard systems optimisation
Farmers ke kaam ki Taylor-style time study
Sirf Weber-style strict rules aur penalties
Soft systems approach: rich picture aur alag worldviews ki root definitions (CATWOE) se situation samjho, phir feasible aur desirable changes par agree karo
questions.explanation: Jab stakeholders ke goals aur worldviews alag hon aur problem khud disputed ho, to ye messy, soft situation hai; SSM pehle alag perspectives saamne laata hai aur phir agreed changes dhoondhta hai. Hard optimisation sabse tempting trap hai, par usse pehle ek agreed objective chahiye jo yahan nahi hai. Sirf rules lagaana bhi un worldviews ko ignore karta hai jinki wajah se rules follow nahi hote.

questions.question: 'Manager ke paas time aur information kam thi, isliye usne pehla theek-thaak option chun liya.' Ye kis thinker ka idea hai?
questions.explanation: Limited time aur information mein pehla 'good enough' option chunna Herbert Simon ka satisficing hai, jo bounded rationality se aata hai. Taylor 'one best way' dhoondhne ki baat karte the, jo satisficing ka ulta hai. Fayol aur Weber structure aur principles ke thinkers hain, decision making ki limits ke nahi.

questions.question: Ek company phone cover aur wallet ko jod kar ek 'wallet case' banaati hai. Ye kaunsa tool aur letter hai?
questions.explanation: Do existing cheezon ko jod kar ek naya product banana SCAMPER ka Combine hai. SWOT company ki internal aur external position dekhta hai, Pareto causes ko priority deta hai, aur five whys root cause dhoondhta hai; inme se koi naya product design karne ka tool nahi.

questions.question: Ek consultant har sawaal ka jawab deta hai: 'It depends: company ke size, technology aur environment par.' Ye kaunsa approach hai?
questions.explanation: 'It depends' aur situation ke hisaab se design contingency approach ka core hai. Scientific management aur bureaucracy dono ek 'best' model har jagah lagaane ki soch rakhte the. Quantitative approach maths models se decisions improve karta hai, par 'situation par depend karta hai' uska central idea nahi.

questions.question: Marketing department ka head har mahine actual sales ko target se compare karta hai aur deviation dikhe to corrective action leta hai. Ye kaunsa management function hai, aur kis business area mein ho raha hai?
questions.explanation: Actual ko standard se compare karna aur corrective action lena controlling hai, aur ye marketing department mein ho raha hai. Yahi course ka point hai: management functions har business area ke andar chalte hain. Trap: controlling ko finance se jodna, kyunki numbers aur targets finance jaise lagte hain; par kaam marketing head ka hai.

questions.question: Ek board ka chairman har meeting mein sabse pehle apni raay deta hai, aur uske baad koi bhi director uske khilaaf nahi bolta, chahe unhe doubts hon. Problem kya hai aur sabse seedha remedy kya hai?
options: Anchoring; chairman ko koi number bolna hi nahi chahiye
Sunk cost; pichhle kharch ko discussion se hatao
Confirmation bias; sirf favour wala data dekho
Groupthink; chairman last mein bole, devil's advocate rakho
questions.explanation: Doubts hone par bhi chup rehna aur leader ki raay par 'sab agreed' dikhna groupthink hai. Janis ke remedies: leader apni raay sabse last mein de, aur kisi ko devil's advocate banao. Anchoring trap hai kyunki chairman ki pehli raay judgement kheenchti hai; par anchoring ek starting number ki baat hai, aur yahan asli issue group mein dissent dabna hai.

questions.question: Case: (1) ek strategy team ne same data se 'premium jao' aur 'sasta jao' ke opposing plans takraaye aur debate se ek naya combined plan nikaala; (2) company ne kai naye businesses mein diversify kiya to har business ke liye alag division banaaya; (3) sales target baar-baar miss hua to target hi neeche kar diya gaya. Kramashah kaunse concepts hain?
options: Hegelian inquiry; Chandler ka structure follows strategy; eroding goals
Kantian inquiry; contingency approach; shifting the burden
Hegelian inquiry; Fayol ka unity of direction; fixes that fail
Lockean inquiry; Chandler ka structure follows strategy; eroding goals
questions.explanation: (1) Opposing views ka debate aur synthesis: Hegelian (Kantian mein complementary models best fit ke liye compare hote, takraate nahi). (2) Strategy (diversification) badli to structure divisional hua: Chandler. (3) Gap band karne ke liye goal neeche karna: eroding goals. Teesra option (3) ko fixes that fail kehta hai, par wahan fix ka side-effect problem waapas laata hai; yahan goal hi khisakaaya gaya. Chautha option (1) ko Lockean kehta hai, jo consensus wala system hai, debate wala nahi.

questions.question: Ek company Section 135 ke under hai. Pichhle teen financial years mein uska net profit ₹180 crore, ₹240 crore aur ₹300 crore tha. Is saal usne CSR par ₹4 crore kharch kiye. Required minimum se kitna kam kharch hua?
questions.explanation: Average net profit = (180 + 240 + 300) ÷ 3 = 720 ÷ 3 = ₹240 crore. Required CSR = 2% × 240 = ₹4.8 crore. Kami = 4.8 − 4 = ₹0.8 crore. ₹2 crore sirf latest year (300) ka 2% = ₹6 crore lene par aata hai, aur ₹10.4 crore teeno ke total (720) ka 2% = ₹14.4 crore lene par. 'Koi kami nahi' tab lagta jab koi 2% ko kisi chhote base par laga de.

questions.question: Ek startup ke orders tezi se badh rahe hain, par customer support team utni hi hai; tickets pending rehne lage aur ratings girne lagi, phir growth ruk gayi. Founder phir bhi ads badhaata hai aur kehta hai: 'Hum ads par ₹2 crore laga chuke hain, ab rukna nahi hai.' Kaunsa archetype aur kaunsa bias dikh raha hai?
options: Limits to growth; sunk cost fallacy
questions.explanation: Archetype: growth ka reinforcing loop support capacity ki limit se takraaya aur balancing loop (pending tickets, ratings) ne growth rok di: limits to growth. Leverage support capacity badhana hai, ads nahi. Bias: '₹2 crore laga chuke hain' past kharch ko future decision ka reason banana hai: sunk cost fallacy. ₹2 crore ek number hai, par woh kisi estimate ko kheench nahi raha, isliye anchoring trap hai.

questions.question: Ek hospital mein do problems hain: (1) known demand ke saath nurses ka minimum-cost shift roster banana, jis goal par sab agree karte hain; (2) naye wing ka purpose kya ho, is par doctors, management aur local community mein gehra disagreement. Kaunsi pairing sabse sahi hai?
options: Dono ke liye hard systems optimisation
Dono ke liye Ackoff ka absolve
questions.explanation: (1) Goal clear aur agreed hai aur problem well-defined, isliye hard systems approach (optimisation, jaise scheduling model). (2) Stakeholders ke worldviews aur goals hi alag hain, isliye soft systems approach (rich picture, CATWOE) pehle chahiye. Pehla option inhe ulta karta hai. 'Dono ke liye hard' sabse common trap hai: (2) mein optimise karne ke liye koi agreed objective hi nahi hai.
